```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5)
```

```{r}
library(pgmcompR)
```

pgmcompR stands on its own, but it converts models to and from the
established R packages, so results can be cross checked and existing code
reused. All these packages are suggested, not required.

```{r, include = FALSE}
have_bnlearn <- requireNamespace("bnlearn", quietly = TRUE)
have_grain <- requireNamespace("gRain", quietly = TRUE)
have_igraph <- requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)
```

## bnlearn

```{r, eval = have_bnlearn}
asia <- example_network("asia")
fit <- as_bnlearn(asia)
class(fit)
fit$lung
back <- from_bnlearn(fit)
all.equal(query(back, "lung", list(xray = "yes")), query(asia, "lung", list(xray = "yes")))
```

Structures also convert, and `learn_structure()` can run bnlearn's
implementations with `engine = "bnlearn"`:

```{r, eval = have_bnlearn}
d <- simulate_bn(example_network("sprinkler"), 2000, seed = 1)
native <- learn_structure(d, "hill_climb")
external <- learn_structure(d, "hill_climb", engine = "bnlearn")
c(native = network_score(native, d, "bic"), bnlearn = network_score(external, d, "bic"))
```

Gaussian networks convert too:

```{r, eval = have_bnlearn}
g <- from_bnlearn(as_bnlearn(example_network("gaussian")))
gaussian_moments(gaussian_joint(g))$mean
```

## gRain

gRain implements junction tree inference. Its answers match pgmcompR's to
rounding error:

```{r, eval = have_grain}
gr <- as_grain(asia)
ev <- list(xray = "yes", smoke = "yes")
gRain::querygrain(gRain::setEvidence(gr, evidence = ev), "lung")$lung
query(asia, "lung", ev)
```

Note that gRbase, which gRain attaches, defines functions with the same
names as some of ours (`parents()`, `nodes()`, `dag()` and others); call
`pgmcompR::parents()` explicitly when both are attached.

```{r, include = FALSE}
if ("package:gRbase" %in% search()) detach("package:gRbase", character.only = TRUE)
```

## igraph

```{r, eval = have_igraph}
ig <- as_igraph(asia)
igraph::is_dag(ig)
igraph::degree(ig, mode = "in")
is_isomorphic(as_pgm(ig), asia)
```

## File formats

Models can be exchanged with other software through files:

| Format | Writer | Reader | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| BIF | `write_bif()` | `read_bif()` | Discrete BNs; used by bnlearn, pgmpy, Weka |
| XMLBIF | `write_xmlbif()` | `read_xmlbif()` | Needs the xml2 package |
| UAI | `write_uai()` | `read_uai()` | BAYES and MARKOV networks; inference competitions |
| JSON | `write_json_model()` | `read_json_model()` | All pgmcompR model types; full precision |
| RDS | `save_model()` | `load_model()` | Native R serialization |

```{r}
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".bif")
write_bif(asia, f)
cat(readLines(f)[1:12], sep = "\n")
identical(model_states(read_bif(f)), model_states(asia))
```

```{r, eval = have_bnlearn}
all.equal(query(from_bnlearn(bnlearn::read.bif(f)), "lung", list(xray = "yes")),
          query(asia, "lung", list(xray = "yes")))
```

Features a format cannot represent (continuous CPDs in BIF, state names
with spaces) raise an error of class `pgm_unsupported_feature` rather than
being dropped silently.
